entry.title: Flipper Zero Update : Wireless Control!
entry.summary:
The latest Flipper Zero update allows full wireless RFID + RF remote control. How will you use this on your next pentest engagement ? Tell us on Twitter !

More
entry.content:
The latest Flipper Zero update allows full wireless RFID + RF remote control.

In the app, all saved RFID (125KHz + 13.56MHz) cards & captured RF signals can be emulated / replayed directly from the application - without touching the Flipper!

How will you use this on your next pentest engagement ? Tell us on Twitter !

entry.title: New Year, New Product: RFID Range Extender
entry.summary:
Lab401 is proud to present it's RFID Range Extender Antennas.
Boost weak RFID readers, or physically teleport the reading zone up to 50cm away. Works wirelessly - no soldering required.

More
entry.content:
Lab401 is proud to present RFID Range Extender Antennas.
Boost weak RFID readers, or physically teleport the reading zone up to 50cm away. Totally passive - no batteries required, and no soldering required.

Initially built the system for a customised hardware project in Europe, we're finally able to release this product publicly!
